latest_release.name: v3.4.1
latest_release.body:
This patch release fixes various bugs. Notably, it also fixes the performance issues with shared links. 

## What's Changed
### 🌟 Enhancements
* feat: futo backups 1.16.0 by @nutgood in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33216
### 🐛 Bug fixes
* fix(server): map .hif to image/heif by @nornewman in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33167
* fix(server): queue job status query by @jrasm91 in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33182
* perf(server): shared links cover query by @jrasm91 in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33179
* fix(web): info panel filename alignment by @Snowknight26 in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33175
* fix(web): highlight advanced search filters with camera filters set by @Snowknight26 in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33193
* fix: filename element on detail panel by @danieldietzler in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33199
* fix: prometheus exporter should listen on all interfaces by @danieldietzler in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33203
* fix: workflow step fields default values by @danieldietzler in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33211

## New Contributors
* @nornewman made their first contribution in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33167
* @nutgood made their first contribution in https://github.com/immich-app/immich/pull/33216

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/compare/v3.4.0...v3.4.1

hot_issues.title: Certain DNG files cannot be processed
Images appear to be randomly corrupted (at least on RK build) with no logs or known reason
Mobile photo backup keeps retrying already-uploaded assets
Immich iOS app doesn't upload but prepares images and taking my space
Hardware acceleration cause video play with stuttering effect

discussions.title: Album editors should be able to edit asset descriptions
[Feature] Duplicates utility: add short-lived undo for keep/trash actions
[Feature] Shared Libraries for Collaborative Photo Management
[Feature] mobile app: add strict local Wi-Fi-only mode
[Feature] Use real-time transcoding when casting videos
[Feature] Add Immich edited pictures to face detection queue
[Feature] Support Chunk-Based and Resumable File Uploads
Free Up Space Keep on device filter should list immich album instead of phone album.
